scene: A screenshot of a 2D side-view video game battle. The place is a misty mountain temple courtyard at dawn, with cherry blossom trees and falling petals. On the left, a young fox-spirit archer with fox ears and a fox tail pulls a glowing arrow. On the right, a dragon knight in jade green armor swings a curved blade. Both are mid-attack and face each other. Simple game UI: two health bars at the top, one for each fighter. At the bottom, a panel with the math question "7 × 8 = ?" and 4 answer buttons: 54, 56, 63, 48. Fantasy East Asian mood. Cool, exciting, and fun for a 10-year-old. No text other than the UI. No logos.

styles.name: Chunky 16-bit pixel
styles.prompt: Art style: chunky 16-bit retro pixel art, like a classic 1990s console game. Big visible pixels, limited color palette, crisp pixel edges, no blur, no anti-aliasing.
styles.note: Pixel art is cheap to animate, and it stays sharp on every screen.

styles.name: HD-2D pixel with light
styles.prompt: Art style: HD-2D. Pixel-art sprite characters placed in a scene with soft 3D-looking depth, warm volumetric light, glow, bloom, and depth-of-field blur in the foreground and background.
styles.note: Pixel characters are cheap to animate. The light and depth need more work in the game engine.

styles.name: Ink-wash brush painting
styles.prompt: Art style: traditional East Asian ink-wash brush painting (sumi-e). Bold black ink brush strokes for the characters, soft grey ink washes for the mountains and mist, rice paper texture, with only a few accents of red and jade green.
styles.note: Ink art looks unique. Each animation frame needs careful brush work, so animation costs more.

styles.name: Cel-shaded TV anime
styles.prompt: Art style: cel-shaded TV animation. Clean bold line art, bright flat colors with one hard shadow tone, painted anime-style background.
styles.note: This style animates well with cut-out parts. Each character needs more art than pixel art.

styles.name: Chibi cartoon mobile game
styles.prompt: Art style: chibi cartoon mobile game. Characters with big heads and small bodies, big expressive eyes, bright saturated colors, thick bold outlines, glossy UI buttons.
styles.note: Chibi characters are easy to read on a small phone screen, and many new skins are easy to add.

styles.name: Watercolor storybook
styles.prompt: Art style: hand-painted watercolor storybook illustration. Soft impressionistic brush strokes, gentle color bleeds, visible paper texture, dreamy light.
styles.note: Watercolor makes very beautiful backgrounds. Animated characters in this style need the most work.
